copy.title: Boltpro Locksmiths | Official Site for Homes & Business
copy.description: Boltpro Locksmiths — professional locksmithing for homes, shops, offices and landlords. Eight branches including the Wirral cluster of Bebington, Heswall and Wallasey, plus Slough, Sunbury, Bromsgrove, Herne Bay and Trowbridge.
copy.topbar: Homes · Shops · Offices · Rental portfolios — one locksmith relationship for all of it
copy.h1: The locksmith your business would choose — at home
copy.lead: Shop shutters at 6am, office master-key systems, HMO compliance for landlords, and the family front door — Boltpro branches handle all of it with the same professional discipline: documented work, scheduled visits that happen on time, and invoices your accountant won't query.
copy.heroNote: {n} branches — including three across the Wirral — serving households, high streets and trading estates.

coverage.heading: Branch directory
coverage.intro: Eight branches, each serving its town's homes and businesses on its own direct number. The areas listed are that branch's regular commercial and residential rounds.
coverage.areaPattern: Homes and premises covered in {areas} and across {town}

services.heading: One firm, both sides of the shopfront
services.intro: The same engineers handle a jammed till-room door at nine and a family lockout at ten — and both get the professional version of the job.
featured: 24/7 priority response for premises and homes — because a shop that can't lock up is as urgent as a family locked out.
Staff changes, tenant turnover, house moves — cylinders and suites changed with keys accounted for in writing.
From BS3621 domestic locks to keyed-alike suites and master-key systems across multiple doors and sites.
Post-incident make-safe with the paperwork insurers and loss adjusters expect, for premises and homes alike.
Shopfronts, offices and houses secured fast — glazing-ready and documented for the claim.
Rated safes for cash handling, documents and home valuables, anchored and certified.
Planned maintenance visits for portfolios and premises, or one-off fixes at home.

why.heading: The professional habits that carry over
points: Every job — domestic or commercial — ends with documentation: what was fitted, to what standard, under what guarantee.
Businesses can't wait in all day, so our branches book time slots and keep them. Households get the same courtesy.
Master-key schedules, restricted profiles and signed key registers for landlords and managers who need to know who holds what.
One front door or forty rental units — the same branch handles both, so growing portfolios never outgrow their locksmith.

cta.heading: Talk to a branch that speaks both languages
cta.sub: Home, business or both — your local Boltpro branch will quote it properly.

copy.footerBlurb: The official site of Boltpro Locksmiths — eight branches delivering professional locksmithing to homes, shops, offices and rental portfolios.
